alarm.title: Alarm
alarm.description: A geofenced location alarm configured by a user

id.description: Unique identifier of the alarm document

name.description: Display name or destination name for the alarm

radius.description: Geofence trigger boundary radius in meters

enabled.description: Whether the alarm is actively monitoring

sound.description: Whether audio chime should play when triggered

vibration.description: Whether vibration haptics should pulse when triggered

alarmTone.description: Identifier of the sound tone to play

userId.description: UID of the user who owns this alarm

createdAt.description: Epoch timestamp in milliseconds when alarm was created

updatedAt.description: Epoch timestamp in milliseconds when alarm was last updated

locationLog.title: LocationLog
locationLog.description: Logged location data when a user opens or runs the application

id.description: Unique identifier of the location log

source.description: Source of location (e.g. gps, ip_coarse, locale_default)

timestamp.description: Timestamp of the location fix in epoch ms

createdAt.description: Timestamp when this log was created in epoch ms
